items.name: River Hill Spring 2019

venue.name: [River Hill High School](https://rhhs.hcpss.org/)
venue.details: Competition is in the cafeteria of the school.

items.information: Lunch (pizza) will be provided for the competitors, and is included in the registration fee. If you prefer something besides pizza, there are many other options near the school. All competitors must read the Competitor Information tab. We may hold a second round of Skewb (Top 16), and then a second round of 2x2 (Top 16) if time allows before 3x3 Final.
